title: Design snapshot component inventory
description: Inventory of published Figma components and component sets. Inventory only: no layout properties, spec values, or token bindings.

id.description: Slug of the full Figma name, keeping / as the group separator. Unique within the file and stable across runs.

name.description: Last segment of the Figma name.

path.description: Preceding segments of the Figma name, in order. Empty for a top-level component.

source.description: Name of the Figma file this component came from. Added in 1.1.0. The same value for every entry when the library is one file.

variants.description: Variant axis name to its sorted list of values. Empty object for a plain component.

variantCombinations.description: Number of variants the set actually contains, not the product of the axes.

deprecated.description: True when the name or description contains 'deprecated', case-insensitive.

key.description: Empty string when the transport cannot supply it.
